GO-2026-6909  crewjam/saml: advisory text says "through v0.5.1" but its range covers all versions. In v0.6.3 Assertion.Issuer is a value type (no nil deref) and Subject.NameID is namespace-qualified. Proven by internal/auth/saml_vuln_test.go. Reviewed 2026-11-09.
